verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of all non-MLP tensors across the three checkpoints before any merging, matches exactly the 48 MLP tensors via a `fullmatch` regex, and computes each task vector against the untouched `base` dict (the output lives in a separate `dict(base)` copy, so no in-place contamination of the reference). Arithmetic is done in float32 and cast back to the original dtype, non-MLP tensors are carried over from the base unchanged with unchanged names, and it asserts both `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114` before writing the single file `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
